remarks:
Spacious Corner-Lot Craftsman — $159,900
3 Bedrooms · 1.1 Baths · 1,200 Sq. Ft. · Detached 2-Car Garage
Beautifully restored Craftsman-style bungalow on an oversized L-shaped corner lot in south Jamestown, just minutes from downtown. Original character blends with thoughtful modern updates, including high ceilings, abundant natural light, hardwood floors, detailed woodwork, and inviting living spaces.

The light-filled interior features a striking Craftsman great room with nearly floor-to-ceiling windows and a classic fireplace, plus an updated kitchen with custom maple cabinetry, honed granite countertops, stainless appliances, and an open connection to the dining room.

Three charming bedrooms, a refreshed period-inspired bath, and a practical full basement provide comfortable everyday living.

Outside, enjoy the covered front porch, mature landscaping, fruit trees, raised garden beds, fire pit, fenced yard, and brick-lined walkways. The detached two-car garage offers updated electrical service, a workbench, wood-burning stove, and half-loft for storage.

Additional updates include plumbing and electrical, high-efficiency natural-gas heating and water heater, smart thermostat, waterproof basement, and full attic storage.

Close to Bergman Park, the farmers market, National Comedy Center, Reg Lenna Arts Center, Southern Tier Brewing Company, and Allegheny State Park.

Classic charm, modern comfort, generous outdoor space —ready to welcome you home.
